sloka: तावप्युभौ मानुषराजपुत्रौ तं गन्धमाघ्राय महौषधीनाम्।बभूवतुस्तत्र तदा विशल्यावुत्तस्थुरन्ये च हरिप्रवीराः ।। ६.७४.७३ ।।
transliteration: tāvapyubhau mānuṣarājaputrau taṁ gandhamāghrāya mahauṣadhīnām।babhūvatustatra tadā viśalyāvuttasthuranye ca haripravīrāḥ ।। 6.74.73 ।।

translations.english: All those Vanara warriors killed were restored with life instantly by the fragrance. Those who were asleep also got up when they became fully awake.
